content: Asian handicap settlement: whole-ball lines (0, 1, 2...) push/refund on exact handicap tie; half-ball lines (-0.5, 0.5, 1.5) cannot push, pure win/loss; quarter lines (0.25, 0.75) split stake across two adjacent half-lines yielding four financial outcomes: full win, half win, push-half refund, half loss, full loss. AH deletes the draw collapsing 3 outcomes to 2. Probability computation from score matrix: sum joint probabilities over scorelines where (goals + handicap) outcome wins/pushes; fair odds = 1/push-adjusted probability needs care: for AH the market has two-way prices with push possibility, so fair price per side derives from win probability while push returns stake. Settlement engine must handle half-win/half-loss P&L, not just win/loss.
